title: Dual Chow polynomials of matroids and posets
summary: We introduce and study dual Chow functions associated to kernels in incidence algebras of weakly ranked posets. Given a kernel, its dual Chow function is defined as the Chow function associated to the sign-twisted reverse kernel. For kernels satisfying a natural skew-symmetry condition, such as the Eulerian kernel of an Eulerian poset or the kernel given by R-polynomials on Bruhat intervals, this construction recovers the ordinary Chow function. In contrast, when this skew-symmetry fails, the dual Chow function gives a genuinely different invariant. The main example considered in this paper…
